system.effect:
Prerequisites: Minor Gift – Guiding Tutelage
Scene – Free Action
Trigger: You or an ally miss all targets with an attack, fail a skill check, or receive massive damage.
Effect: If triggered by missing all targets, the triggering character gains +2 accuracy for the Scene.
If triggered by failing a skill check, the next skill check the character rolls treats the lowest die as a 6 instead.
If triggered by massive damage, the character receives 2 ticks of Temporary Hit Points, and may clear one injury or status condition.
